why: usd charges the published book on the assumption that a client buys the ask and sells the bid. Two earlier buys (PETR4, overnight ACA) had printed on the bid, so a same-session round trip was needed to see whether a trip actually crosses.

open.note: ACHETER showed 18.370 then 18.365; fill equals the ask button.

close.note: VENDRE showed 18.360; fill equals the bid button.

reconcile.verdict: Buy at the ask, sell at the bid, P&L is exactly (18.36 − 18.365) × 10. The trip crossed the book. usd is right to charge it.
